abort.already_configured: This Intiface server is already configured.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Intiface at that URL.

start_pattern.name: Start pattern
start_pattern.description: Runs a single wave or pulse cycle, optionally repeated. Wave-only fields are ignored for a pulse pattern and vice versa.

target.name: Target
target.description: Device slug (e.g. lovense_hush), or "all" for every connected toy.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: How many times to repeat the single wave/pulse cycle.

min_speed.name: Min speed (wave)
min_speed.description: The wave's trough — its speed at the start and end of each cycle.

max_speed.name: Max speed (wave)
max_speed.description: The wave's peak — its speed at the midpoint of each cycle.

duration.name: Duration (wave)
duration.description: How long one single wave (min → max → min) takes, in seconds.

low_speed.name: Low speed (pulse)
low_speed.description: Speed during the low phase of each pulse cycle.

high_speed.name: High speed (pulse)
high_speed.description: Speed during the high phase of each pulse cycle.

low_duration.name: Low duration (pulse)
low_duration.description: How long the low phase lasts, in seconds.

high_duration.name: High duration (pulse)
high_duration.description: How long the high phase lasts, in seconds.

stop_pattern.name: Stop pattern
stop_pattern.description: Stops any running pattern for the given target.

target.name: Target
target.description: Device slug, or "all" for every connected toy.
